authorization: 2026-11-14 owner asked to launch the previously proposed quantum calculations while capacity is available
scope: GQC numerical accuracy, finite-state chemical sensitivity, and eight explicitly prepared competing paths for candidates A-D
rationale: Live inspection found two other GPU jobs on a four-GPU node; this campaign is capped at two GPU workers and two CPU workers. This supersedes the earlier single-job planning cap for this request only.
claim_limits: Software agreement is not chemical accuracy.
CCSD(T)/cc-pVDZ is a finite-basis reference, not exact or experimental truth.
Continuum-solvent single points are sensitivity probes, not solution free energies.
A proposed endpoint or NEB maximum is not a verified reaction; saddle, frequency and bidirectional connectivity checks are required.
No trained model or sealed test labels are used.
